what: Inductor-fused backbone SwiGLU over the packed gate/up projection
why: The SwiGLU chain was the largest remaining non-GEMM block in the all-on profile: aten::mul 3.6%, silu 1.2%, silu_backward 0.9% and the chunk-backward aten::cat 1.4%, about 7% of kernel time.
why_not_the_published_kernel: fla.modules.activations.swiglu reads two contiguous inputs. Here gate/up are strided views of one packed [.., 2*ffn] projection (the official Qwen checkpoint layout) and that kernel returns wrong values on strided input without raising (measured relative error 1.414). Forcing contiguity copies ~400 MB per call and drops the kernel win from 1.77x to 1.15x. Inductor reads the strides directly.

covers: strided input asserted, not merely accepted
reentrant checkpoint, which is how the model actually calls it
odd token count, for dynamic shapes

attribution: PRETRAIN_CUDA_FUSED_SWIGLU is its own switch, split out of PRETRAIN_CUDA_FUSED_OPS so this A/B moves one variable and run.json records which one.
